name: xuexitong-auto-player
description: 学习通自动刷课浏览器扩展

scripts.test:prepare: mkdir -p tests/fixtures tests/browsers && (test -f tests/fixtures/test.webm || ffmpeg -y -f lavfi -i testsrc=duration=30:size=320x240:rate=10 -c:v libvpx -an tests/fixtures/test.webm) && (test -d tests/browsers/chromium && echo chromium-ok || npx --yes @puppeteer/browsers install chromium@latest --path tests/browsers)
